title: Smoggy
description: You can only play [blue]1[/blue] Skill per turn.
smart_description: You can only play [blue]1[/blue] Skill per turn.
notes: After you play a Skill, this power applies Smog affliction to all Skills without afflictions. Any Skills that enter combat during a turn where a Skill was already played also receive Smog. All Smog afflictions clear at end of turn.
